name: Mbala
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Mutanda, Albert 1964. Esquisse phonologique et morphologique de la langue mbala; Makila 1977 Etude phonologique et morphologique. Not online.

sources.citation: Torday, E. & Joyce, T.A. 1905. Notes on the ethnography of the Ba-Mbala. Journal of the Anthropological Institute 35: 398-426.
sources.note: 'Language' section (p.~420) plus vocabulary; no remark on accent or stress.

sources.citation: Bostoen, K., Pacchiarotti, S. & Kouarata, G. 2025. Language divergence and convergence and deep-time population history in the Kwilu-Kasai region. Ch. 6 in the BantuFirst Kwilu-Kasai volume (Routledge, OA via UGent biblio).
sources.note: Checked for Mbala K51: language not mentioned; irrelevant.

sources.citation: Ngalasso Mwatha Musanji 1991. Tons ou accents ? Analyse des schemes tonals du kikongo parle dans la region de Bandundu (Zaire). Etudes creoles 14(2): 147-162. doi:10.3406/ecreo.1991.1369
sources.note: About Kikongo ya leta, not Mbala. p.158 attributes Kikongo tone scheme IV (H on prefix, L on all stem syllables) to loans from Kimbala at Kikwit; fn.7 p.161: 'Sur l'intonation du kimbala voir Ndolo (1972)'. No statement on Mbala word stress.

sources.citation: Kama Funzi Mudindambi 1977. Recits mbala. Africana Linguistica 7: 247-267. doi:10.3406/aflin.1977.903
sources.note: Nothing on word stress. p.249 gives tone-marking conventions only ('accent aigu/grave/vertical' = H, L, downstepped H diacritics; unmarked syllable copies preceding tone) and notes phrase-final vowel devoicing before pause.

sources.citation: Meeussen, A.E. 1977. Trois pronominaux du mbala. Africana Linguistica 7: 359-373. doi:10.3406/aflin.1977.905
sources.note: Nothing. Introduction (p.361) explains tone transcription (musical-note letters s f m r d) and refers to Ndolo 1972 for tonal terms 'abaissement, depression, nivellement'; the analysis is entirely tonal; notes Kama's dialect differs from Ndolo's.

sources.citation: Koni Muluwa, Joseph & Bostoen, Koen. 2015. Lexique compare des langues bantu du Kwilu (Republique democratique du Congo): francais-anglais-21 langues bantu (B, C, H, K, L). Koln: Rudiger Koppe. 197 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Modern fieldwork covering Mbala K51; introduction describes transcription (tone, length) per language and may state whether prominence is tonal or penultimate.

sources.citation: Mudindaambi, Lumbwe. 1981. Grammaire mbala. Bandundu: CEEBA (Centre d'etudes ethnologiques de Bandundu); cf. also his Dictionnaire mbala-francais, 4 vols, 1977-81, CEEBA serie III.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained

sources.note: A full grammar by a native-speaker scholar; CEEBA grammars usually open with phonology incl. tone/accent.
